rules.title: Blood Magic
rules.description: Maximum mana is zero. Active skills spend life; costs cannot kill you.

rules.title: Iron Fortress
rules.description: Evasion modifiers contribute to armor. Evasion becomes zero.

rules.title: Elemental Avatar
rules.description: Convert all physical damage equally to fire, cold and lightning. Deal only those damage types.

rules.title: Last Stand
rules.description: 40% more melee damage while low life.

rules.title: Pain Attunement
rules.description: 30% more spell damage while low life.

rules.title: Perfect Form
rules.description: 25% more attack damage while full life.

rules.title: Pristine Mind
rules.description: 25% more spell damage while full life.

rules.title: Desperate Focus
rules.description: 35% more spell damage while low mana.

rules.title: Mana Blade
rules.description: 35% more melee damage while low mana.

rules.title: Twin Fangs
rules.description: 35% more melee damage while dual wield.

rules.title: Blood Scripture
rules.description: Spells spend life instead of mana; +2 Blood spell levels and no mana regeneration.
